s.note: an East End seafood stall, without the jellied eels
s.how: Flake 250g smoked mackerel, removing the skin and bones. Blitz with 150g cream cheese, 1 tbsp horseradish, lemon juice and black pepper until mostly smooth. Spread on toasted rye and top with thin cucumber slices.

Score 500g pork rind into strips, rub well with salt and dry uncovered in the fridge overnight. Roast on a rack at 220C for 30 minutes until puffed and crackling. Spray or brush lightly with 2 tbsp malt vinegar while hot, then toss in more sea salt flakes. Tip into paper bags.

m.note: the debt collector who brings his son along
m.how: Brown 1kg diced beef chuck with 2 onions and thyme, add 375ml ale and braise 2.5 hours. Thicken, pour into a dish, cover with puff and bake at 200C for 25 minutes. Fry 1kg thick chips twice. Crush 300g cooked peas with butter and mint.

w.how: Rub 100g butter into 250g self-raising flour, stir in 75g sugar and 150g currants, then add 150ml milk to a soft dough. Press into a greased basin, cover with paper and foil and steam for 90 minutes. Turn out and serve with hot custard.

d.n: Two smoking barrels peated whisky sour
d.note: the two antique shotguns everyone is chasing
d.how: Mix 2 tbsp honey with 2 tbsp warm water for honey syrup. For each drink, shake 50ml peated Scotch whisky, 25ml lemon juice, 15ml honey syrup and 1 egg white hard without ice, then with ice. Strain into a tumbler over ice and dot the foam with aromatic bitters.
